test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 21 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The difference of the present ages of two friends Gopal and Manoj is 2 years. If the ratio of their ages after 18 years from now will be 21 : 22, then find the sum of their respective ages 10 years ago from now (in years).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

After 18 years ratio = 21 : 22 ⇒ difference = 1 part

Actual difference always same = 2 ⇒ 1 part = 2

Ages after 18 years ⇒ 42 and 44

Present ages ⇒ 24 and 26

10 years ago ⇒ 14 and 16 ⇒ sum = 30

**∴ Answer = 30**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Difference of present ages = 2 years

Ratio after 18 years = 21 : 22

**Formula used:**

Let ages be (21x − 18) and (22x − 18)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Difference = (22x − 18) − (21x − 18)

⇒ = 22x − 18 − 21x + 18

⇒ = x

⇒ Given difference = 2 ⇒ x = 2

⇒ Present ages = 21×2 − 18 = 24 and 22×2 − 18 = 26

⇒ Ages 10 years ago = 24 − 10 = 14 and 26 − 10 = 16

⇒ Sum = 14 + 16 = 30

**∴ The correct answer is 30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Difference Rule

Difference of ages remains constant over time.

Ratio Concept

If ratio is a : b, then actual ages = ax and bx.

Time Shift Method

Future age = Present age + years, Past age = Present age − years.
